public.text: REDDHI is rightly defined as a condition of maturity to be approached gradually and verified through observable signs — but the draft offers no structured self-assessment instrument with which a country can locate itself and plan progression.
public.suggestedRevision: Connect REDDHI to the existing tradition of maturity models — for example SCIROCCO, the European twelve-dimension self-assessment for integrated-care readiness, used for planning rather than grading — or provide a REDDHI maturity instrument with dimensions and observable indicators.
